items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through a template engine injection flaw. Adobe released a fix on October 13, 2026, but a manual patch is required, and new installations may still be vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (September isolated patch)
items.summary: This bulletin provides a September isolated patch addressing moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, actively exploited in the wild since September 4th, 2026. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento admin takeover
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: CVE-2026-48356 is a remote code execution vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types. Adobe released patches addressing this as part of the APSB26-73 security bulletin.
